name: perseus
display_name: Perseus — Live Context for MCP Hosts
description: Perseus Context Engine prepares operator-selected workspace context for compatible AI agents before execution.
long_description:
Perseus prepares current workspace context before an AI agent runs. It resolves operator-authored directives into a bounded artifact.

- **Current context** — render explicitly allowed project and repository state

- **MCP interface** — connect a compatible host to the Context Engine

- **Local default path** — the default renderer uses local workspace sources; authored HTTP directives, optional transports, and external integrations can send operator-selected data to configured destinations

- **Operator controlled** — shell and network modes require explicit configuration and retain the current user's permissions

- **Perseus Vault integration** — optional governed durable memory through a local MCP backend; see the [versioned Vault MCP API reference](https://perseus.observer/vault/mcp-reference/) for its published surface

Install: `pip install perseus-ctx==1.0.26 && cd your-project && perseus quickstart`
